steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: Dammit!

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: Those cowards, hiding behind their bunkers. We don't really know the lay of the land behind the wall, so it's hard to break through their defenses.

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: How much longer until Talulah gets here?

steps.name: Reunion Member B
steps.text: There's a lot of enemies on her side, I reckon she'll need a little more time.

steps.name: Reunion Member B
steps.text: Like she said, all we have to do is pin down the defenders until she comes to reinforce—

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: Err... What was that—
As soon as the words leave his mouth, another shell flies over his head, heading towards his comrades behind him.
Just as he thinks about telling them to duck for cover, a drone swoops past him, intercepting the shell in midair. Even so, the resulting explosion shakes the ground.

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: Wh-What the... Closure?!
Behind him, countless whirring drones rise into the air, whistling as they fling themselves into the incoming shells.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Heh, no need to wait for her to save you.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Thanks to you guys buying time, my EM interference countermeasure's complete.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Bunkers scanned, enemy signals marked, spontaneous combustion safeguards disabled—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Go, show them what you've got!
The drones head towards the stone wall's gates one after the other. Not long after, explosions and the wails of Ursine soldiers ring out from behind the bunkers.
The defenders were clearly caught on the back foot by this chaotic assault. They flail at the flying lumps of iron, unable to conceal their positions any longer.

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: Since when were drones this useful? If we had this kind of firepower...

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: Whatever, now's our chance! Charge!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hehe...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Mission complete!
She lets out an involuntary snap of the fingers.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Heh, we took care of this spot earlier than planned. The side gate is ours.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But there's still plenty of defenders inside, Talulah. I'll need your help.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Understood.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Go find the Rhodes Islanders, Closure. Leave the soldiers to me. Reunion will make sure they don't get in your way.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I still have quite the score to settle with these people.

steps.name: Voice from Communicator
steps.text: ...Bzzt... Hailing... Colonel Nikonov...

steps.name: Voice from Communicator
steps.text: ...The enemy's breached the wall, lighting fires everywhere they go. Nobody's answering when I call the garrisons...

steps.name: Voice from Communicator
steps.text: ...Need a report on your command center, stat. The fuel factory's our top priority. We need to protect the Infected resources, we can't let them fall into enemy hands! If there's any danger, execute the contingency plan—
A hand reaches out, picking up the communicator on the fallen man's body.
What contingency plan?

steps.name: Voice from Communicator
steps.text: ...Who are you?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The one who picked up this communicator. Your colonel died by my hand not too long ago.

steps.name: Voice from Communicator
steps.text: What do you think you're doing?!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: All you need to know is that you're next.
She clenches her fingers. The voice whines as the communicator is crushed, the shattered fragments slipping between her fingers, tinkling as they fall onto the floor.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We've taken care of the remaining soldiers outside, Talulah. Plan said Closure's going ahead to find the Sarcophagus, while Sirka's looking for the Generalik.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: As for the 'fuel factory' we're searching for, some of our captives said it's here.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: How convenient. One of their officers said the same thing just now.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Open the door.
The steel door slowly swings open, revealing rows of man-sized vats inside. A few people narrow their eyes. They may be veterans of the battlefield, but they still dread what they are about to see.
But they are surprised. This place is not exactly the same as the factory outside. These vats have red lights flashing under them. Talulah steps forward, peering into the first vat she sees.
She sees a young woman, her body intact. Countless slender tubes are attached to her mouth and nose, the Originium crystals on her body glimmering a dark yellow.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: These lights are on, unlike the ones in the expansion plate...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: I saw it! That girl's eyelids just twitched!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: They can still be saved. Turn off the main breaker first.
As the breaker switch is pulled with an ear-piercing screech, a blade flashes.
The glass in front of Talulah shatters into pieces, the oily preservation fluid gushing out and splattering across her feet.
The woman is slowly pushed out the vat by the force of the spilling liquid. Talulah helps her up with one hand, using her other to pull away the tubes all over her.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Still conscious... Quick, save the rest of them!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Got it!

Renewed hope snaps everyone out of their reverie. The dread they felt earlier has become a force propelling them as they charge towards the rest of the vats. For a moment, all that can be heard in the room is the sound of glass breaking and varied greetings.

steps.name: Rescued Infected
steps.text: ...I... Am I safe...?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Yes, you're safe.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I swear to you, you will never have to see those people ever again.

steps.name: Rescued Infected
steps.text: Reunion...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Rescued Infected
steps.text: You must be... Only Reunion would save us. I knew it, everyone knew it...

steps.name: Rescued Infected
steps.text: When they brought us here, many people cried, especially the children... Until some people told us stories about you. Everyone... began to believe.

steps.name: Rescued Infected
steps.text: But those officers stopped us, saying Reunion was just a bunch of crazy terrorists...

steps.name: Rescued Infected
steps.text: But we're in Ursus. Only madmen care about the Infected in the first place.

steps.name: Rescued Infected
steps.text: Thank... you...

steps.name: Rescued Infected
steps.text: But... where's the white-haired Liberi? Isn't she with you?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What did you say? A white-haired Liberi?

steps.name: Rescued Infected
steps.text: Before you arrived, a white-haired Liberi came by. She told us we had to hold on, that people would be coming to save us soon!

steps.name: Rescued Infected
steps.text: And she said—

steps.name: Koshelna
steps.text: Never give up struggling. The meek will become weak.

steps.name: Koshelna
steps.text: Only those with strength have the right to survive.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We've gotten the rest of them out, Talulah. We need to be quick, the other factories have Infected waiting for us.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Right. Help her up, and get her out of here.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'll take care of this place.
The two leave, her comrade propping up the weakened young woman as they go. Talulah slowly gets up, walking towards the door before turning her head.
The 'factory' now lays still. Spilled fluid coats the entire floor, reflecting the last vestiges of light in the distance.
She stretches out her hand, as if waving goodbye. Flames spring out of every corner of the room, engulfing the turquoise stone.
The endless toil of the Infected stops now.

steps.name: Sirka
steps.text: ...Nobody here?
There is not a soul in the giant room, only a fireplace that crackles as it burns.

Sirka approaches the desk. Books and files are scattered all over it. She rummages through them, pulling out a sheet covered in symbols from the bottom of the pile, a shiny fresh signature in the bottom right corner.

steps.name: Sirka
steps.text: ...Anatoliy—
Who's there?

steps.name: Confused Soldier
steps.text: Hmm? Strange... I heard a voice just now.
Suddenly, he feels an iron grip around his neck, one strong enough to lift him off his feet. He is flung into a pillar, which breaks with a dull thump.
Before the lone soldier can recover from the head-churning dizziness and pain, a knife is pressed against his back. It slips through his clothes, its tip sticking ever so slightly into his skin.

steps.name: Sirka
steps.text: Anatoliy's whereabouts, or your life.

steps.name: Panicked Soldier
steps.text: I... I'll talk!

steps.name: Panicked Soldier
steps.text: It was a few hours ago... The Generalik got some news, so he left this place with his bodyguards in a hurry.

steps.name: Sirka
steps.text: What news?

steps.name: Panicked Soldier
steps.text: I don't know...

steps.name: Panicked Soldier
steps.text: AHH—

steps.name: Panicked Soldier
steps.text: H-He said: 'Those degenerates are unfit to have a piece of Zelgrad', then he got really angry, saying he had to take something away.

steps.name: Sirka
steps.text: 'Those degenerates'? Where did he go after that? Is he still in the city?

steps.name: Panicked Soldier
steps.text: He looped around a few of the labs—they all had something to do with the prototype core—then he headed for the east of the city... Please, I don't know anything about what he was talking about!

steps.name: Sirka
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Sirka
steps.text: Just to be safe, you cannot tell anyone that I was here.

steps.name: Panicked Soldier
steps.text: Yes, yes, I would never—
Before he can even finish, the knife has pierced his chest, nailing him to the pillar as blood streams down it.
Sirka shakes the blood off her blade as she looks outside the window.

steps.name: Sirka
steps.text: 'Prototype core'. Is that the 'Sarcophagus' they were talking about...?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Ursus sees the Sarcophagus as a giant energy source. Nothing beyond that function matters to them at all.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: The researchers here had no way of breaking through the lockdown procedure Kal'tsit implemented, so they decided to use brute force to crack it open.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Based on what I can see, we're now in our worst-case scenario. The Sarcophagus's biological restoration function is completely destroyed...

options: Do we still have a chance?
Surely there's still some hope left?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It's still possible if we can restore everything perfectly!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: But there's something we need to take care of first. The Sarcophagus's control system is extremely damaged! It's very unstable right now.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I knew it... The researchers had to rely on massive amounts of Originium to just barely keep it stable. Now that the Originium supply is gone, it's about to go critical.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: The Sarcophagus is constantly leaking out that infectious bio-dust even now, and its energy output is fluctuating heavily!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: If the energy contained within goes completely out of control and escapes, I'm afraid it's not just going to be all of Zelgrad that's razed to the ground...

spans.text: If the energy contained within goes completely out of control and escapes, I'm afraid it's not
going to be all of Zelgrad that's razed to the ground...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mon3tr! Can we still shut it down?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I'm trying my best here!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I can't just flip the switch Kal'tsit installed, I need to begin with a complete control system—Basically, I need time!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's the soldiers outside! Are they still trying to force their way in?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: No, the entire building is under attack.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: This is the First Army we're talking about. Were they prepared to completely destroy the place?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Do these damn reckless Ursines ever think about the consequences?!
As the building shakes, countless strange, monstrous creatures gush out of the Sarcophagus's core in an unending stream.
They appear to be lost and afraid, milling about in confusion within the enclosed space.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Those are like that organism I saw that night—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Amiya, Raidian! Do NOT let those things touch you!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Shit, if only I had a hand free—

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: How much time do you need, Mon3tr?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Around... forty minutes.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Don't get distracted. I'll protect Amiya and the Doctor.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Sorry for making you do this, Dive...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wait, there's movement outside. The door might not hold much longer!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Get behind me, Doctor, I'll protect you—

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: No, this signal is familiar—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Whew... Made it! Did I get here on time?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Closure?!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Amiya! I knew you guys could do it! I was still really worried, though!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Eww, the heck are these things crawling on the ground?!

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Watch out! Those infected lifeforms are dangerous, don't let them touch you!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Then what should I do? Will they explode or something?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I need you to help limit their movement range. My little Cycle doesn't have enough ammo.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: So you're just lacking firepower? This'll be a cinch, then!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Zeroth Order Oil Tank!
An orderly array of drones rises up into the air behind Closure, like an impenetrable wall.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I always thought this move was too unsporting, so I never pulled it out in a real combat situation... but it's finally coming in handy now.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Perfect timing for a field test of those weapon modules I just installed...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Zeroth Order Oil Tank, identify targets, then wipe them all out!

options: Closure! How did you get in here?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: A genius hacker-engineer has her ways! Though I did run into a fair few helpers along the road here...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: That ID code Gummy got us turned out pretty handy, too. You'll never guess who I ran into outside the wall, Doctor!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I knew you guys would find the Sarcophagus core. So, can we finally—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Closure! Help me!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Okay, coming!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It's rare seeing you this stressed out, Mon3tr. What's the sitch?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: THE SARCOPHAGUS IS ABOUT TO EXPLODE!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...IT WHAT?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Raidian...

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I'm... fine...

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: How long has it been?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: About an hour.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Believe in them...
Raidian and Closure's drones work together to form a defensive line, corralling the dangerous infected creatures within a safe zone.
At the other end of the room, Mon3tr and Closure are hard at work at the control panels.
Everyone stays silent. Nobody dares to ask if their labors have borne fruit.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Doctor, we...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Nonononono—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We did so many tests, we should know this thing inside and out, so why—
Closure keeps mumbling. Despite her best efforts, the Sarcophagus does not respond to her, yet she keeps working its controls.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Doctor... The Sarcophagus is at its limit. We don't have time to shut it down using the proper protocols.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: The only thing we can do now, before it goes out of control and unleashes disaster...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Is to destroy it completely.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Doctor... It's time to decide.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: If... If Kal'tsit were here, she'd agree to it.
Mon3tr speaks as calmly as possible, rendering the cruelest of judgments.
There is no time.
The Sarcophagus is no longer something that gives you hope you can bring your comrade back, but instead something that threatens to wipe out everything.
Though you harbored the sincerest of wishes, you must now make the decision to abandon your one and only chance. You must decide.

spans.text: Though you harbored the sincerest of wishes, you must now make the decision to abandon your one and only chance.

steps.text: Why are you hesitating?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: Pretty rare to see you so careless. Distracted by something?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Yeah... I'm worried about the team that went to Ursus.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Having to wait for such up-in-the-air results isn't a very nice feeling.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: You've never been like this in front of the Doctor.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I just didn't want to bring down morale, doesn't mean I don't care.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Once you're as old as me, you'll know what this sort of separation feels like.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: Not exactly the nicest thing you could wish me...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Whew... And with that, Engineering is now rebuilt! That was one hell of a project!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: When the Doctor and Amiya bring Dr. Kal'tsit back, they'll be in for a shock!

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: It really was quite the project...

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Not to be a downer, but are you really so sure the Doctor will succeed?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Of course I am.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I believe in the little bunny and the Doctor. It's that simple.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: No particular reason?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: If we needed reasons to believe in each other, we might as well quit being elite operators, right?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Fair enough.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: We should get their welcome party ready.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Like we always do.

options: How much longer are you going to keep your secrets?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We've discussed this. I thought we had reached an understanding.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You cannot simply ask people to pass your memories like they are a cup of coffee. Anything relayed to you by others lacks objectivity.

options: Are you planning to just watch as I stumble in the dark?
It's hard for an amnesiac to do their job.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Believe me when I say that you are not the only person who has to bear the vexation of not getting what they want.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: One day in the future, you will understand my patience.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will not tell you about your past of my own accord, but I will help you in all other matters when needed.

options: If you care about me, or if you want to make things difficult for me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I really do care about you, far more than you can imagine.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Like I have said before, I will restrain myself and not allow my hatred towards you—or any other emotion—to cloud my judgment.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But I will always protect you, until you recover your memories, or you find yourself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Only once that time comes can we discuss what it means for you to exist here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You've already found yourself, haven't you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You fully understand your duty, and know the road you insist on walking.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So go, make what you have always believed was the right choice.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'Protect the life on this great land'...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island will not stop because of the loss of any one person.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You will all see a different tomorrow.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Did you do something just now, Mon3tr?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: What...? No, not a thing!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But then why would a backdoor with such high authorization suddenly appear in the system? If it was here all along, how come those researchers never found it?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Waitwaitwait, this isn't just your regular security vulnerability... Why does the Sarcophagus's OS have an independently-operating program like PRTS?!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It's slow-going...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But it's shutting down the Sarcophagus!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Could it be—

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I want to fix it too.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Not only does AMa-10 carry our hopes, it has also preserved a record that is very important to me.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Already on it! Just need a little more time!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Five minutes... No, three! Just buy me three! I've still got a shot!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: But the Sarcophagus is extremely dangerous right now! I don't know how much longer it will hold!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What... What if we can suppress its energy? Will it stabilize?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Amiya?!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Absolutely not! Not even you can hold back its power output by yourself!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If we don't try... then how can we ever know...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Besides, I can feel... the Black Crown answering my call...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I believe I can do it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa... Have you come to help me?

steps.name: Civilight Eterna
steps.text: Amiya... I have not.

steps.name: Civilight Eterna
steps.text: Your request violates the baseline command Theresa installed in me—

steps.name: Civilight Eterna
steps.text: No matter the situation, prioritize Amiya's safety. Your safety.

spans.text: No matter the situation, prioritize Amiya's safety.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But you also said I shouldn't make a choice I would regret.

steps.name: Civilight Eterna
steps.text: Are you sure you wish to do this, Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This time... I will do everything I can. Everything.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't want to lose anyone by my side again.
The ancient superstructure lets out a terrifying whine. You can feel your innards vibrate alongside it, even though all you are doing is standing nearby.
You are unable to comprehend the frightening amount of energy contained by this machine.
Amiya stretches out her hands towards it. Black Arts flow from her fingertips, holding firm as they suppress the sheer force pouring out of the Sarcophagus. Its core begins to calm.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Urghhhh—!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Amiya!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm fine... Don't worry...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The day... The day Dr. Kal'tsit shielded me, is a day I'll never forget...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Every time, it's someone else who protects me...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But this time... I won't let go this time—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can—
Once more, you witness pure power burst out of Amiya's slight frame.
You stretch out your own arm to support her. You too can sense the churning sea of emotion, the font of her strength.
Unwavering determination, countless regrets, the dread of separation... and a warmth that now only exists in memory, a deep reluctance to say goodbye.
You have all walked this long path together. You have all lost so much along the way.
You do your best to prop her up by the shoulder, trying to calm her like you always do, and share in her pain... But all that power, all that roiling emotion, is endlessly deep.
You can clearly hear the sound of some instrument shattering.

options: How much longer do we need to hold?!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Soon—No, it's done!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: That's enough, Amiya!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It's stopped, but—
